failures.fix: Update sw-cleanup.sh to scan heartbeat files for staleness in dry-run mode and output a summary line with 'Found N items' and '--force' hint when items are detected

failures.root_cause: sed command uses a literal string 's|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g' as a filename instead of as an expression, missing the -e flag
failures.fix: Change 'sed s|...|g' to 'sed -e s|...|g' or quote the expression correctly so sed treats it as a substitution command
